subject: general
question: What is the national male workforce participation rate as per the Census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.5326**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The national male workforce participation rate as per the Census of India 2011 is **0.5326**.
 
• This figure indicates the proportion of the male population that is actively engaged in the labor market, either by working or seeking work.
 
• Workforce participation rate is a crucial indicator of economic activity and labor market dynamics.
 
• The data from the Census of India provides valuable insights into the employment trends and economic contributions of the male population in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and provides comprehensive data on various demographic parameters.
 
• Workforce participation rates can vary significantly between different regions and demographic groups within the country.
 
• Understanding workforce participation helps in formulating policies aimed at improving employment opportunities and economic growth.
 
• The Census of India 2011 also provides data on other key indicators such as literacy rates, population growth, and household characteristics.
